title: Electrolyte tailoring and interfacial engineering for safe and high-temperature lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05263C, Paper

Chenyang Shi, Zhengguang Li, Mengran Wang, Shu Hong, Bo Hong, Yaxuan Fu, Die Liu, Rui Tan, Pingshan Wang, Yanqing Lai
By replacing the inert, strongly positive electrostatic potential of TTE with the active, weakly positive electrostatic potential of MDFSA, thermally resistant interfacial films are formed, enhancing the battery's performance at high temperatures.
